summary: The prepared main checkout already contains upstream PR #32430's issue-specific correction for compressed-tensors NVFP4 MoE W13 layout. The affected Qwen3.5 MoE checkpoint uses FlashInfer CUTLASS, which requires [up; gate], but v0.5.16 loaded the default [gate; up]. Current source selects [up; gate] for CUTLASS, retains [gate; up] for TRT-LLM before its explicit reorder, and forwards the scheme choice through CompressedTensorsFusedMoEMethod. Added a focused regression for those boundaries and forwarding behavior.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: CUTLASS layout selection and wrapper propagation failed; TRT-LLM and default-scheme boundary cases passed (2 failed, 2 passed). Raw output: reports/j-5b24e7d0d313/regression-before.txt
Passing-after regression on prepared main: CUTLASS [up; gate], TRT-LLM [gate; up], default [gate; up], and wrapper propagation (4 passed). Raw output: reports/j-5b24e7d0d313/regression-after.txt

Assigned device is AMD Instinct MI350X, ROCm 7.2, capability tuple (9, 5); the production compressed-tensors NVFP4 scheme explicitly requires NVIDIA Blackwell. Raw output: reports/j-5b24e7d0d313/gpu-environment.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: The assigned gfx950 GPU was enumerated, but no issue-path kernel was executed because CompressedTensorsW4A4Nvfp4MoE rejects non-Blackwell platforms. The original report and upstream validation use NVIDIA Blackwell.
remaining_limitations: The 21.9 GB affected model weights were not downloaded and the full Ornith serving/generation path was not reproduced on the assigned AMD GPU.
No NVIDIA Blackwell GPU was available, so the corrected FlashInfer CUTLASS NVFP4 MoE kernel was not numerically revalidated locally.
Candidate status relies on exact source-path regression evidence plus upstream PR #32430's real Blackwell result (GSM8K 0.00% before, 93.93% after), not a local full-model claim.
